Big River Thursday Night Ride (RINEMBA)

West Greenwich, RI · Mountain bike

Big River Thursday Night Ride (RINEMBA) is a mountain bike group ride in West Greenwich, RI. It rolls every Thursday at 5:30 pm from Exit 21 Park and Ride.

For visitors

Night ride, bring a bike light. Register through the NEMBA event listing.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: two groups, fast and mellow. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Big River Thursday Night Ride (RINEMBA) group ride

A weekly night mountain bike ride at Big River Management Area, a large trail network off I-95. NEMBA runs it as two groups, fast and mellow, so there is a pace for most riders.
